sources.title: PFRLCD Power Factor Regulator MODBUS-RTU user manual (Mikro Sdn Bhd)
sources.note: Copy of the manufacturer's manual held by the Internet Archive; no itmikro.com.my link to this PDF was found.

notes: Modbus RTU over RS-485, regulator is the slave. Functions 03 (read holding), 04 (read input), 06 and 16 (write). Baud rate 9600 or 19200 (default 19200), parity none, odd or even (default even; none needs 2 stop bits), default slave address 1.

The manual's Modbus table lists the product information, measurements, harmonics, alarm and step status as read-only (function 04), so they are input registers; the control parameters (function 3, 6 and 16) are holding registers. Writing needs 'Remote Set' to be enabled on the regulator's panel, otherwise the settings can only be read. Addresses are the decimal numbers of the manual, address base 0.

Floating-point values (format F1) are IEEE 754 single precision with the two least significant bytes at the lower address and the two most significant at the next, so the word order is little (low word first); the byte order inside a register is taken as big-endian.

Harmonic values (format F2) are given as unsigned integers but the manual says -1 marks a measured value below the threshold; they are listed as int16, x/10 percent. The harmonic index starts at 0 as printed in the manual.

The control parameters pack two values in one register (high and low byte); each register is listed whole with the layout in the description. Reserved registers 14 to 16, 312, 315 and 316 are left out. The product information registers are ASCII text, two characters per register (see the description of each).
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Alarm status
registers.description: Format F18. High byte: bit 8 %THDI, 9 under current, 10 over current, 11 under voltage, 12 over voltage, 13 under compensate, 14 over compensate, 15 step error. Low byte: bit 0 CT polarity, 1 temperature high, 2 low voltage release

registers.name: Displacement PF1
registers.description: Format F19: signed integer from -100 to 100, x/100

registers.name: Displacement PF2
registers.description: Format F19

registers.name: Displacement PF3
registers.description: Format F19

registers.name: Step output status
registers.description: Format F20: bit 0 is step 1 ... bit 11 is step 12 (bits 8 to 11 not used on 8-step models); 1 = step off, 0 = step on

registers.name: Switching program and C/K setting
registers.description: Format F4. High byte b11-b8: 0 manual, 1 rotational, 2 four-quadrant, 3 automatic, 4 linear. Low byte: C/K setting 3 to 121 (121 = AutoCk), x/100

registers.name: Reconnection time and target power factor
registers.description: Format F5. High byte: reconnection time 5 to 240. Low byte: power factor setting 80 to 120 (80 = 0.80 inductive, 98 = 0.98 inductive, 100 = 1.00, 102 = 0.98 capacitive, 120 = 0.80 capacitive)

registers.name: Rated step 1 and 2
registers.description: Format F6. High byte: step 1 coefficient, low byte: step 2. Valid values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 12, 16, 255 (fixed)

registers.name: Rated step 3 and 4
registers.description: Format F6

registers.name: Rated step 5 and 6
registers.description: Format F6

registers.name: Rated step 7 and 8
registers.description: Format F6

registers.name: Rated step 9 and 10
registers.description: Format F6; not applicable on 8-step models

registers.name: Rated step 11 and 12
registers.description: Format F6; not applicable on 8-step models

registers.name: Detection phase
registers.description: Format F7. High byte b11-b8: 0 L1, 1 L2, 2 L3, 3 three phase, 4 maximum load; low byte not used. Not applicable to single phase models

registers.name: Alarm setting for under current and over current
registers.description: Format F9. High byte: under current 1 to 15 (x/100, 0 = off). Low byte: over current 1 to 16 ((x+54)/10, 0 = off)

registers.name: Alarm setting for under voltage and over voltage
registers.description: Format F10. High byte: under voltage limit 195 to 204 (0 = off). Low byte: over voltage limit 1 to 12 (x+252, 0 = off)

registers.name: Fan temperature and alarm setting for over temperature limit
registers.description: Format F11. High byte: fan temperature limit 20 to 35. Low byte: over temperature limit 36 to 70 (0 = off)

registers.name: Set slave address and baud rate
registers.description: Format F12. High byte: slave address. Low byte bit 0: baud rate (0 = 19200 bps, 1 = 9600 bps)

registers.name: Set parity and fan setting
registers.description: Format F13. High byte b9-b8: parity (0 none, 1 odd, 2 even). Low byte b3-b0: fan setting (b0 none, b1 fixed on, b2 output on, b3 temperature)

registers.name: Sensitivity
registers.description: Format F16: 5 to 300

registers.name: Alarm setting for %THDI limit
registers.description: Format F8: 20 to 300 in %, 0 = off

registers.name: Signal contact and alarm settings
registers.description: Format F14. High byte b10-b8: signal contact (1 alarm, 2 none). Low byte b3-b0: 1 = on for under compensate (b0), over compensate (b1), step error (b2), CT polarity error (b3, single phase model only)

registers.name: Signal contact alarm linkage 2 and signal contact alarm linkage 1
registers.description: Format F15. High byte, 1 = linked to the signal contact: b8 %THDI, b9 under current, b10 over current, b11 under voltage, b12 over voltage, b13 under compensate, b14 over compensate, b15 step error. Low byte: b0 CT polarity error (single phase only), b1 over temperature
